audit_principle: A native claim must be invariant under the declared equivalence on native objects; an observable that changes under presentation equivalence is not a native invariant. Existential witnesses cannot discharge universal or canonical claims.

questions.mother_question: Is the complete native rotation group of bare P000 equal to the carrier S4 readout?
questions.object: Bare-P000 model M with primitive relational structure, not a chosen carrier presentation.
questions.observable: Accepted carrier edge-action S4 readout on six axis types.
questions.quantifier_level: Universal over the intended bare-P000 model class.
questions.minimal_rewrite: For an explicitly declared model category C and primitive-preserving Aut_native, classify rho_M:S4_carrier->Aut_native(M) (existence, kernel, image, normalizer); assert Aut_native(M)=S4 only as a separate theorem.

questions.mother_question: Does the Gen12 faithful split witness imply that every bare-P000 model admits a simultaneous S4 lift?
questions.object: The class of models satisfying exactly bare-P000 primitives plus any explicitly stated Full-Cell hypotheses.
questions.allowed_equivalence: Model isomorphism preserving the declared primitive language.
questions.observable: Existence of one Gen12 K4 four-Cell split lift.
questions.claimed_invariant: Every allowed model admits such a lift.
questions.quantifier_level: Existential witness being used as a universal model-class conclusion.
questions.minimal_rewrite: Fix a model class C. Ask separately whether some M in C has a split faithful lift and whether every M in C admits a homomorphic section q_M; never infer the universal statement from the existential witness.

questions.mother_question: For a specified enriched Full-Cell model M and actual q:Gtilde->S4, does a homomorphic section exist?
questions.object: Exact enriched automorphism group Gtilde(M) with a declared surjective axis-readout homomorphism q.
questions.allowed_equivalence: Isomorphisms of extensions commuting with q.
questions.observable: The set Sec_hom(q) of homomorphic sections.
questions.minimal_rewrite: No change beyond requiring Gtilde and q to be actual enriched automorphism/readout objects rather than formal generators.

questions.mother_question: If chosen lifts A,B satisfy A^3=B^2=(AB)^4=1, must the enriched group be S4 or have trivial kernel?
questions.object: An extension q:Gtilde->S4 together with chosen lifts A,B.
questions.allowed_equivalence: Extension isomorphisms commuting with q and preserving chosen-lift data when it is declared presentation data.
questions.observable: The three relation residues of the chosen lifts.
questions.claimed_invariant: Kernel K is trivial and Gtilde is S4.
questions.quantifier_level: Implication from one finite observable tuple to the whole extension.
questions.minimal_rewrite: Use trivial residues only to certify that the chosen generators define a split section under the S4 presentation hypotheses; classify K independently.

questions.mother_question: When are zero relation residues equivalent to existence of a split S4 section?
questions.object: A surjective q:Gtilde->S4 and lifts A,B with q(A)=a,q(B)=b for the frozen (3,2,4) generators.
questions.claimed_invariant: The assignment a->A,b->B extends to a homomorphic section.
questions.quantifier_level: Existence of a section from one compatible generating pair.
questions.minimal_rewrite: State q(A)=a, q(B)=b, q surjective and the exact S4 presentation <a,b | a^3=b^2=(ab)^4=1>; then zero residues are equivalent to the chosen pair extending to a homomorphic section.

questions.mother_question: Is an existing S4 lift or section canonical?
questions.object: An extension q:Gtilde->S4 with its primitive-preserving extension automorphism group Aut_q(Gtilde).
questions.allowed_equivalence: Extension automorphisms commuting with q; for a model family, natural isomorphisms in the declared category.
questions.quantifier_level: Uniqueness/fixed-point or naturality claim, stronger than existence.
questions.minimal_rewrite: Define canonical as a section fixed by every primitive-preserving q-automorphism, or as a specified natural transformation across a declared model category, then compute the automorphism orbit of Sec_hom(q).

questions.mother_question: Is a chosen per-Cell frame f_x:A->C_x itself native data?
questions.object: A Cell with primitive PF-10/full relational content before choosing channel trivialization.
questions.allowed_equivalence: Local channel gauge/relabelings preserving the primitive Cell structure.
questions.observable: Concrete bijection f_x from abstract axes to channel labels.
questions.claimed_invariant: The displayed frame is intrinsically determined.
questions.minimal_rewrite: Treat frames as a torsor/trivialization and ask whether primitive structure defines an Aut-invariant section; otherwise only correctly transported gauge-invariant observables may be native.

questions.mother_question: Does local S6 channel-relabel symmetry of the bare PF-10 presentation equal the native P000 rotation group?
questions.allowed_equivalence: Primitive-preserving native isomorphisms; local presentation gauge is not automatically native motion.
questions.observable: S6 acting on six presentation channel labels.
questions.quantifier_level: Identification of a presentation automorphism group with a native symmetry group.
questions.minimal_rewrite: Keep S6 as the automorphism/gauge group of the channel presentation and separately construct a typed homomorphism from any proposed native motion group into presentation relabelings.

questions.mother_question: May carrier vertices/edge labels be identified with native Cell identities because a witness uses the same numeric labels?
questions.object: Two different sorts: carrier vertices/axis types and opaque native Cell identities.
questions.allowed_equivalence: Independent relabeling within each sort unless a typed bridge is explicit structure.
questions.quantifier_level: Identity assertion from a presentation alias.
questions.minimal_rewrite: Use disjoint tagged sorts CarrierVertex/AxisType and NativeCell; introduce only typed bridge maps that are explicit structure and test their equivariance.

questions.mother_question: Does Omega_b/contact matching characterize existence of native base rotation R_b?
questions.object: A framed Full-Cell model with base action, PF-10 state and optional contact-route data.
questions.allowed_equivalence: Full-Cell isomorphisms preserving declared typed relations.
questions.claimed_invariant: Omega_b iff a base R_b exists.
questions.quantifier_level: Universal biconditional across the model class.
questions.minimal_rewrite: Retain only that on Omega_b the contact match is readable from PASS; treat R_b existence by the full automorphism/equivariance criterion independently of Omega_b.

questions.mother_question: Does flat connection data imply a globally reconstructed frame?
questions.object: A graph/groupoid connection with loop-holonomy representation.
questions.observable: Local curvature/flatness terminology and edge transports.
questions.claimed_invariant: Existence of one global parallel frame.
questions.quantifier_level: Global existence from local transport constraints.
questions.minimal_rewrite: Replace ambiguous flatness by: a seed extends to a global parallel frame iff transport is synchronizable/pure gauge, equivalently all loop holonomies are trivial in the declared connected setting.

questions.mother_question: Do identical carrier readout and identical chosen generator relations determine the same native enriched object?
questions.object: Whole enriched extension q:Gtilde->S4 including hidden kernel action on native relational state.
questions.allowed_equivalence: Isomorphisms of enriched extensions preserving the typed native action.
questions.observable: Carrier S4 image plus the three chosen relation residues.
questions.minimal_rewrite: Treat readout+residue as a quotient observable; classify kernel K and its native action separately, then ask whether the extension is determined up to typed isomorphism.

countermodels.construction: Use the abstract six-edge S4-set of K4. In presentation P, b=(AB) fixes E1,E6. Re-present by tau=(E1 E2); the same abstract b is represented by tau b tau^-1 and fixes E2,E6, so E1 changes from fixed to moved.
Let Gtilde=S4 x C2 and q be projection. s0(g)=(g,0), s1(g)=(g,parity(g)) are homomorphic sections; F(g,e)=(g,e+parity(g)) is a q-preserving automorphism swapping them.
Compare S4 with S4 x C2 under projection. Chosen lifts have identical S4 readout and A^3=B^2=(AB)^4=1, but kernel orders are 1 and 2 and group orders 24 and 48.
On four opaque Cell identities with adjacency not fixed by bare P000, K4 has automorphism group S4 of order 24 while path P4 has automorphism group C2 of order 2.

rules: NATIVE_OBJECT_TYPED: object specified independently of chosen coordinates/presentation.
INVARIANCE_TEST: a native invariant must survive every allowed equivalence; one exact failure forces PRESENTATION_DEPENDENT.
QUANTIFIER_TEST: existential evidence cannot discharge universal, uniqueness or canonicality claims.
CANONICALITY_TEST: a canonical choice is fixed by relevant primitive-preserving automorphisms or is natural in an explicit category.
PROXY_TEST: same observable with different target native property implies STRICTLY_WEAKER_PROXY.
HYPOTHESIS_TEST: equivalence requiring extra hypotheses is marked EQUIVALENT_AFTER_EXPLICIT_HYPOTHESES and rewritten with them.
SORT_TEST: CarrierVertex/AxisType and NativeCell remain disjoint unless a typed bridge is declared.
KERNEL_TEST: quotient/readout data cannot silently erase hidden kernel or relation residue.
EVIDENCE_TEST: killed/repaired questions cite exact finite countermodels, exact equivalence proofs or frozen accepted guards.

continue_targets: Actual enriched automorphism groups and q:Gtilde->S4 for explicit model classes.
Kernel and relation-residue classification without quotienting.
Gen12 as K=1 split faithful existential regression only.
Exact split-section criteria and automorphism-orbit/naturality canonicality tests.
Tagged carrier/Cell sorts and trivial-holonomy terminology.
pause_or_rewrite_targets: carrier S4 = complete native P000 rotation group
chosen frame = native identity without definability
